summary: 36-year-old climber stranded on a scree/boulder field on Maroon Peak called for help ~9:45 p.m. via a two-way emergency communication device and spent the night with emergency supplies; 15 Mountain Rescue Aspen personnel deployed ~5:57 a.m. Tuesday, contacted him ~9:50 a.m., and he walked out under escort; all clear by 1:20 p.m.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen / Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
notes: Sole source is a content-farm rewrite citing a Pitkin County Sheriff's Office release; no independent corroboration found (two parent searches 2026-10-16); details per the PCSO statement quoted in the article.
